title: Set 264

sentences.ko: 이번엔 진짜 설탕 없이 11일이나 버텼어. 내 최고 기록이야. 근데 누가 회사에 도넛을 사 왔고, 반 개만 먹자고 마음먹었는데 결국 두 개를 먹어 버렸어. 그러니까 또 월요일부터 다시 시작해야겠지.
sentences.text: I actually made it eleven days without sugar this time, which is a record for me. But then somebody brought donuts into work, and I told myself I'd just have half of one, and I ended up eating two. So I guess I'm starting over on Monday again.

alts.text: Eleven days with no sugar this time, a new record for me! Then someone shows up at work with donuts, and I'm like, okay, just half. Ended up eating two. So yeah, starting over Monday. Again.

This time I managed eleven days without sugar, which is a personal record. However, a colleague then brought donuts into the office, and although I told myself I would have only half of one, I ended up eating two. I suppose I will be starting over again on Monday.

sentences.note: **made it eleven days** 는 11일을 버텼다, 해냈다는 뜻이에요. **ended up eating two** 처럼 **ended up** 은 그럴 생각이 없었는데 결국 그렇게 됐을 때 씁니다.

sentences.ko: 자전거는 좋은데, 미리 말해 두자면 비에 젖으면 뒷브레이크에서 끽끽 소리가 좀 나. 그러니까 한번 점검받아 보는 게 좋을 거야. 그래서 150달러 안 받고 100달러만 부르는 거야.
sentences.text: It's a good bike, but I should tell you the back brake squeaks a little when it's wet, so you might want to get that looked at. That's why I'm only asking a hundred for it instead of one fifty.

alts.text: Good bike, but heads up, the back brake squeaks a bit when it's wet, so maybe get it checked. That's why I'm only asking a hundred, not one fifty.

It is a good bicycle; however, I should mention that the rear brake squeaks slightly when it is wet, so you may wish to have it inspected. That is why I am asking only one hundred dollars rather than one hundred and fifty.

sentences.note: **get that looked at** 은 남에게 맡겨서 한번 봐 달라고 하다, 점검받다는 뜻이에요. casual 의 **heads up** 은 미리 알려 줄게, 참고로 정도의 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 중고로 물건 팔면서 상태 솔직히 말하기

sentences.ko: 색은 너한테 정말 잘 어울리는데, 한 치수 큰 것 같아. 어깨 쪽이 좀 흘러내리거든. 아직 교환할 수 있으면 나라면 작은 걸로 입어 볼 것 같아.
sentences.text: I really like the color on you, but I think it's a size too big, because it's kind of hanging off your shoulders. If you can still exchange it, I'd try the smaller one.

alts.text: Love the color on you, but I think it's a size too big. It's kinda hanging off your shoulders. If you can still swap it, I'd go for the smaller one.
The color suits you very well, but I believe it is one size too large, as it appears to be hanging off your shoulders. If an exchange is still possible, I would suggest trying the smaller size.

sentences.note: **a size too big** 는 한 치수 크다는 말이에요. **hanging off your shoulders** 는 옷이 커서 어깨에서 흘러내리는 모습을 말합니다.
sentences.situation: 친구가 산 옷 어떠냐고 물었을 때 솔직하게 말하기

sentences.ko: 토요일에 친구한테 끌려서 스피닝 수업에 갔거든. 예전에 자전거를 많이 탔으니까 괜찮을 줄 알았어. 근데 지금 계단도 겨우 내려가. 게다가 하루 종일 으슬으슬한 걸 보니 몸살 오려나 봐.
sentences.text: My friend dragged me to a spin class on Saturday, and I figured I'd be fine because I used to bike a lot. But now I can barely walk down the stairs, and on top of that I think I'm getting sick, because I've been freezing all day.

alts.text: So my friend dragged me to spin class Saturday, and I thought I'd be fine since I used to bike a ton. Now I can barely get down the stairs, and I've been freezing all day, so I think I'm getting sick too.

A friend persuaded me to attend a spin class on Saturday, and I assumed I would be fine because I used to cycle frequently. However, I can now barely walk down the stairs, and I believe I am also becoming ill, as I have felt extremely cold all day.

sentences.note: **dragged me to** 는 가기 싫은 데를 억지로 끌고 갔다는 뜻이에요. **on top of that** 은 안 좋은 일을 하나 더 얹을 때 쓰는 게다가입니다.

sentences.ko: 응, 엄마, 다 괜찮아. 요즘 일이 좀 정신없긴 한데 괜찮고, 응, 밥 잘 먹고 있어. 아니, 기분 상한 거 아니야. 그냥 피곤해서 그래, 방금 집에 들어왔거든. 이번 주말에 전화할게, 알았지?
sentences.text: Yeah, Mom, everything's good. Work's been a little crazy, but it's fine, and yes, I'm eating. No, I'm not upset, I'm just tired, I only just got home. I'll call you this weekend, okay?

alts.text: All good, Mom. Work's kinda nuts right now, but it's fine, and yes, I'm eating. No, I'm not mad, just tired, I just walked in. I'll call you this weekend, okay?

Yes, Mom, everything is fine. Work has been somewhat hectic, but it is manageable, and yes, I am eating. No, I am not upset; I am simply tired, as I have only just arrived home. I will call you this weekend, if that is all right.

sentences.note: **Work's been a little crazy** 는 요즘 일이 좀 정신없다는 말이에요. **only just got home** 은 방금 막 집에 왔다는 뜻이고, casual 의 **I just walked in** 도 같은 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 부모님 안부 전화에서 잘 지낸다고 둘러대기

reviewed: 2번 formal: 돈 단위가 빠져 있어서 dollars 를 넣었습니다. 한국어는 이미 달러로 적혀 있습니다.
3번 ko: 흘러내리는 것은 어깨가 아니라 옷이라서, 영어 뜻대로 어깨 쪽이 흘러내린다고 고쳤습니다. 끝 문장도 영어의 I'd try 에 맞게 자연스럽게 다듬었습니다.
4번 ko: 너무 추운 걸 보니 는 날씨 이야기처럼 들립니다. 영어의 freezing 은 몸이 으슬으슬하다는 뜻이라 그렇게 고치고, 제목에 맞춰 몸살로 바꿨습니다.
5번 formal: 엄마를 Mother 라고 부르면 비꼬거나 딱딱하게 들립니다. 말투만 올리면 되니 Mom 으로 되돌렸습니다.
